title: a failed constructor does not destroy the unfinished receiver but cleans owned fields
purpose: Observe failure, cleanup and lifetime ordering during execution.

stdout.text:
destroy child
construction failed
holder ready
holder destroyed
destroy child

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.4: a failed constructor's receiver destroy is not invoked, while owned resources are cleaned; IMP-09: a resource bound to a field of the object under construction is released when construction fails. A completed holder destroys parent before owned child.
